h:
通过使用外画添加角色周围的环境来创建有趣的壁纸。 Then it progressively increase the resolution in multiple stage to add more details and make the composition blend together.

每个阶段都有多个提示来调整。它应该与任何 SD SDXL 小马等一起使用。默认情况下，我的设置使用 SD 1.5 进行阶段，然后在最后两个阶段切换到小马。

每个阶段都有一个保存节点。还可以选择使用 Civitai meta daya 保存最终结果，或者使用工作流程将其保存为 4k/8k 的 webp 格式。

它使用几个自定义节点，因此最好让 ComfyUI Manager 安装缺少的节点。
https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager

在当前设置下，在 7900xt 上生成所有阶段大约需要 80 秒。

o.en:
Create interesting wallpaper by using outpainting to add the environment around the character. Then it progressively increase the resolution in multiple stage to add more details and make the composition blend together.

There are multiple prompt to adjust each stage. It should work with any SD SDXL Pony ect.. By default my settings use a SD 1.5 for the stages then it Switch to a Pony for the two final stages.

There is a saving node for each stage. And the option to save the final with Civitai meta daya or in 4k/8k in webp with workflow.

It use a couple of custom nodes so it might be a good idea to get ComfyUI Manager to install the missing node.
https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager

Generating all the stage take about 80 sec on a 7900xt with the current setting.
